text_block_list.text:
Before starting training, I talked to Fine 
Motion about today's menu, but...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Got it! Let's go with a different menu 
today♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Because it looks like it'll be way more 
fun that way! You can make the 
adjustments, right?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I've already got an idea♪ Well then, let's 
get started right away!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Um, if I remember correctly, when making a 
wish...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Just one more push, perhaps? Let's try 
a slightly different approach then...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
*Ahem!* You there... Are you saying you 
refuse to grant my request?!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
If you don't listen to me, I'm gonna sulk! 
Hmph!

And so, I ended up going with the menu 
Fine Motion selected.
